sections.section_title: SYSCFG VDD compensation cell status register (SYSCFG_VDDCCSR)
sections.text_helper: Section 16.1.23 "SYSCFG VDD compensation cell status register (SYSCFG_VDDCCSR)" in chapter 16 (System configuration controller (SYSCFG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 823.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x068
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reset by system reset.
Bits 31:9 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 8 READY: Provides the compensation cell status of I/Os supplied by VDD
0: VDD I/O compensation cell not ready
1: VDD I/O compensation cell ready
Bits 7:4 APSRC[3:0]: This value is provided by the cell, and can be used by the CPU to compute an I/O
compensation cell code for PMOS transistors.
This code is applied to the I/O compensation cell when CS = 0 in SYSCFG_VDDCCCR, and
READY = 1.
Bits 3:0 ANSRC[3:0]: This value is provided by the cell, and can be used by the CPU to compute an I/O
compensation cell code for NMOS transistors.
This code is applied to the I/O compensation cell when CS = 0 in SYSCFG_VDDCCCR, and
READY = 1.
